materials.title: 目的、不定式与动名词

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

questions.prompt: Why does Lena visit college in this sentence: “Lena visits the college to ask about a course”?
options: Because she already has a degree.
questions.evidence: Lena visits the college to ask about a course.
questions.explanation: to ask 表示她去学院的目的。

questions.prompt: Complete the purpose: She goes to the library ____ a book.
questions.evidence: Lena visits the college to ask about a course.
questions.explanation: 表示目的用 to + 动词原形，因此 to find。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct purpose sentence.
options: We meet to discuss the project.
We meet discuss to the project.
We meet to discussed the project.
We meet to discussing the project.
answers: We meet to discuss the project.
questions.evidence: Lena visits the college to ask about a course.
questions.explanation: to discuss 用不定式表达会面的目的。

questions.prompt: In “to ask about a course,” which form follows to?
options: The base form of the verb.
answers: The base form of the verb.
questions.evidence: Lena visits the college to ask about a course.
questions.explanation: ask 是动词原形，表示目的时 to 后用原形。

questions.prompt: I want ____ more about the river.
questions.evidence: I want to learn.
questions.explanation: want 后接 to + 动词原形 learn。

questions.prompt: We plan ____ research at the library.
questions.evidence: We plan to do research.
questions.explanation: plan 后接 to do，而非 to doing。

questions.prompt: She decided ____ one evening free.
questions.evidence: She decided to keep one evening free.
questions.explanation: decided 为过去时，但 to 后 keep 仍用原形。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.evidence: I want to learn.
questions.explanation: want 后用 to learn；不接 to learning。

questions.prompt: I enjoy ____ about local history.
questions.evidence: I enjoy reading.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动词-ing，read 变 reading。

questions.prompt: I want to avoid ____ too late.
questions.evidence: I want to avoid studying too late.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动词-ing：studying。

questions.prompt: I finish ____ the report before dinner.
questions.evidence: I finish writing the report.
questions.explanation: finish 后接动词-ing，表示完成写作。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly describes an enjoyable activity?
questions.evidence: I enjoy reading.
questions.explanation: enjoy 的宾语可用 reading，不能在此用 to read。

materials.instructions: 先阅读说明与例句，再作答并根据解释订正。
materials.passage:
1. to + 动词原形可以说明目的，相当于“为了”：Lena visits the college to ask about a course. 这里 to ask 说明她去的目的；不写 to asking。目的不定式与表示方向的介词 to 不同。

2. want / plan / decide 后常接 to + 动词原形：I want to learn. We plan to do research. She decided to keep one evening free. 第三个例句主句为过去时 decided，后面的动词仍用原形 keep；不要写 decided to kept。

3. enjoy / avoid / finish 后接动词-ing：I enjoy reading. I want to avoid studying too late. I finish writing the report. enjoy 后不能用 to read；finish writing 表示完成写作，不是开始写。动词-ing 在这些例句中是动词的宾语。

materials.instructions: Read the passage and choose ONE answer for each question.
materials.passage:
Lena wants to return to education after several years away from study. She works during the day, so she visits a local college to ask about an evening course. A friendly adviser explains that visitors can attend one sample lesson before they choose. Lena does not need a degree to join the introductory classes, and she can study one subject at a time.

The adviser gives her a map of the campus and invites her to a lecture about learning as an adult. After the talk, a graduate describes how she managed her time while working. She enjoyed reading on the bus and decided to keep one evening free for family. Lena likes the practical advice because she also needs a realistic weekly plan.

In the next room, people in a small seminar are discussing how a town changes over time. Participants compare old photographs, share questions and take notes. The teacher offers a tutorial for anyone who wants individual help after the group discussion. Lena learns that a seminar usually asks students to contribute, while a lecture often gives more time to the speaker.

A science teacher shows visitors a safe experiment with water and light in a supervised laboratory. She explains that biology, chemistry and physics can each ask different questions about the world. In the sample activity, students write a short report to describe what they observe. They do not need to know the answer before they begin; careful notes matter more than a quick guess.

Another classroom is displaying projects that connect history and geography. One pupil from a nearby school has drawn a map showing how a street looked in the past. The display also includes a literature project in which students write about a place in a story. Lena thinks the different subjects could help her understand her own neighborhood.

At the advice desk, she asks about homework and assessment. The adviser says that one assignment asks students to do simple research and write an essay. A teacher gives comments on the first draft before the final version is handed in. The curriculum also includes basic algebra for students who want to work with numbers. Lena is relieved to learn that help is available if a topic feels difficult.

Lena plans to take the local evening class first. If she enjoys it, she may later apply to a university, but today she wants to make one manageable decision. She writes the class time in her calendar and takes the teacher's contact details. Her aim is not to finish quickly; it is to build a study habit she can maintain.

questions.explanation: Eli 纠正 essay 的猜测，作业为短报告。

questions.prompt: What will Maya ask about before paying?
options: The start time of the first lesson.
The subjects included in the course.
questions.evidence: I plan to finish reading the course description tonight and ask about the fee before I pay.
questions.explanation: Maya 支付前会询问费用。

materials.instructions: Listen to the two speakers and choose ONE answer for each question. The facts differ from the reading.
materials.transcript:
Maya: Have you decided on a course at the college yet?
Eli: I have chosen the evening science course. I want to learn more about the river near my home, and the curriculum includes a project about local water.
Maya: That sounds useful. Is the first lesson on Monday?
Eli: No, it is on Wednesday at seven. The adviser said the classroom is in the older building on campus, next to the library.
Maya: What will you do in the first week?
Eli: We will hear a short lecture about asking clear questions. Then we will have a seminar to discuss possible topics in small groups.
Maya: I enjoy reading about geography. I might join you to understand how the river changes through the town.
Eli: Please do. The teacher also offers a tutorial on Friday for students who need help with the assignment.
Maya: What is the assignment? An essay?
Eli: A short report. First we plan to do research using the library's books. Then we decide what information belongs in the report.
Maya: Will there be an experiment in a laboratory?
Eli: Not in the first week. Later, a biology teacher will show us how to observe water plants safely. A chemistry teacher will help another group.
Maya: I hope the homework is manageable. I work full time, and I want to avoid studying too late every night.
Eli: The teacher recommends two short study periods a week. The final assessment is a project and a discussion, not a long examination.
Maya: Good. Do I need a university degree to join?
Eli: No. A graduate I met said people with different levels of education are welcome. She also studied history and literature at the center.
Maya: I will register tomorrow, then. I plan to finish reading the course description tonight and ask about the fee before I pay.
Eli: Great. I will bring my notebook on Wednesday so we can compare ideas after the lecture.

materials.instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
materials.prompt: Describe a course you would like to take. Explain the subject, what you want to learn, why you want to study it, and how you will manage the work. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
materials.reference: I would like to take an evening course at a local college. I want to learn about geography because I enjoy reading about places and people. I plan to visit the campus to ask about the curriculum and the time of each lesson. A short lecture could introduce a topic, and a seminar could give students time to discuss it. I would like to do research about my neighborhood and write a report. I work during the day, so I want to avoid studying too late. I will finish my homework in two short sessions each week. If I need help with an assignment, I will ask the teacher for a tutorial.

materials.title: Explain a Study Plan

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

materials.instructions: Write your own first draft and submit it for feedback.
materials.prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend about a course you would like to take. Explain your purpose, what you plan or decide to do, what you enjoy or want to avoid, and how you will complete an assignment. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Organize four parts: course and reason; learning purpose and activities; a manageable study routine; assignment and help. Check to + base verb after plan and -ing after enjoy or avoid.
